known_change_since_1756: harbour works at Palermo, Messina and Catania; the 1908 Messina earthquake altered parts of the Straits shoreline
scale_of_change: local, order of a few km2
treatment: recorded as a known limitation; the interior is not withheld on account of it
note: The canonical geography adopts the PRESENT-DAY coastline as physical substrate. That is not a reconstruction of the 1756 shoreline. Note that the near-absence of tide in the Mediterranean removes the largest single mechanism by which a mean-high-water coastline can differ from a conventional island outline.
